description: This script is a Python utility for packaging a skill folder into a distributable .skill ZIP file. It validates the skill folder, checks for required files such as SKILL.md, runs validation, and creates a ZIP archive of the skill directory excluding certain version control and cache directories.

methods.name: bool _is_within(path: Path, root: Path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within a specified root directory.

methods.name: package_skill(skill_path, output_dir=None)
methods.description: Packages the specified skill folder into a .skill ZIP archive, performing validation and excluding certain directories and symlinks.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, handling arguments and invoking the packaging process.
